verdict.rationale: Retell ships Conductor, a built-in AI assistant that lets users build/refine agents, run simulations, inspect knowledge bases, investigate calls, and build dashboards via plain-language requests with review-before-apply changes, directly matching delegation of tasks to an in-product AI assistant. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of Conductor specifically (community evidence only covers voice agent behavior, not Conductor itself).
